summary: Plymouth County, MA: a 38' Chelmsford tower moved here in 1918, replaced by a 68' iron tower, closed 1986; sold and dismantled in 2002 for a Minnesota farm.

facts.design: 68' iron tower (second tower on the site, after a 38' tower moved from Chelmsford)
facts.status_note: Tower sold at auction in 2002, dismantled and moved to a Minnesota farm; no source read describes what remains at the site

events.note: Old 38' tower moved from Chelmsford and erected here. The chapter's 2017 post gives 1919
New 68' iron tower built. The chapter's 2017 post says it was built in 1932
Closed at the end of the 1986 fire season
Sold by auction, dismantled, and moved by its new owner to his farm in Minnesota
Added to the Former Fire Lookout Sites register September 3, 2008; nominated by Henry Isenberg

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register dates the move of the old 38' Chelmsford tower to 1918; the chapter's 2017 post says 1919. The story gives 1918 from the register and notes the post's 1919 date.
The register dates the new 68' iron tower to 1930; the chapter's 2017 post says 1932. The story gives both and attributes each.

notes_for_editor: Brief status 'gone' and kind 'tower' look right: the site is gone and the tower was moved to Minnesota in 2002. Two dates conflict between the register and the chapter (1918 vs 1919 move; 1930 vs 1932 replacement), and both are reported. The Minnesota farm's location is not given in either source; the Minnesota fire tower history page checked did not mention Carver. The register's SW Line Road and the chapter's Lower College Pond Road are both recorded, as the register and chapter give them. A second chapter post (search snippet only, not loadable here) also says replaced in 1932; not used. No access level is recorded: neither source states public access to the spot. The NHLR Carver Fire Tower (US 733) is a separate record and is not covered here.
